methodology.metrics: Subjective point-in-time engineering estimates, not test-measured progress; phase scores not mathematical averages of items
methodology.noDoubleCount: Addenda, technologies, gates and requirements are cross-cutting views. Do not add their scores to the primary roadmap total.
methodology.meaningOfZero: No implementation evidence sufficient to award progress; may include completed design or research.
methodology.meaningOf100: Estimated complete for the narrowly named item, not whole-project deployment proof.
methodology.validationRule: CI source compile does not prove live device or production validation
methodology.futureUpdates: Retain immutable baselinePercent. Edit currentPercent only after evidence with links, date, owner, test result and acceptance criteria.
